scenes.line1: How well do you know HTTP?
scenes.line2: Would you spot a proxy issue?
scenes.say: How well do you know HTTP? Would you spot a proxy issue in an interview?

scenes.label: Methods
scenes.sub: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE are the basics.
scenes.say: HTTP methods are the verbs: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE. Most requests use these.
Headers like Host, Authorization, Cache-Control, and X-Forwarded-For control routing, access, caching, and reveal client IPs.
HTTP status codes: Two hundred means OK, three hundred is redirect. Four hundred is client error, five hundred is server error.

scenes.label: Keep-Alive
scenes.say: Keep-alive lets HTTP reuse connections, making requests faster and reducing overhead.

scenes.question: How do you test if an issue is LB or app?
scenes.right: Hit the backend directly with curl and set the Host header.
scenes.say: How do you test if an issue is the load balancer or the app? Don’t just check logs. Hit the backend directly with curl and set the Host header.
